action.action-desc: Ms. Pressley (for herself and Mr. García of Illinois) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Financial Services

form.official-title: To amend the Expedited Funds Availability Act to require that funds deposited be available for withdrawal in real time and to require the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System to create a real time payment system, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Payments Modernization Act of 2019.

section.header: Requirement that funds deposited be available for withdrawal in real time

subsection.text: Section 603 of the Expedited Funds Availability Act (12 U.S.C. 4002) is amended—

paragraph.text: in subsection (a)—

clause.text: by striking Except as provided in subsection (e) and in section 604, in and inserting In; and
in the matter following subparagraph (B) by striking not later than the business day after the business day on which and inserting in real time when;

subparagraph.text: in paragraph (2) by striking not later than the business day after the business day on which and inserting in real time after; and
in the subsection heading by striking Next Business Day and inserting Real Time;

paragraph.text: by striking subsection (b) and inserting the following:

subsection.text: Funds deposited in an account at a depository institution by a check drawn on a local or nonlocal originating depository institution shall be available for withdrawal in real time.

paragraph.text: by striking subsection (c);
by striking subsection (d);
by redesignating subsections (e) and (f) as subsections (c) and (d), respectively;
in subsection (c), as redesignated by paragraph (5)—

clause.text: by striking Not more than 4 business days shall intervene between the business day a and inserting A;
by inserting a comma after subparagraph (B);

paragraph.text: in subsection (d), as redesignated by paragraph (5), by striking (c), or (e) and inserting or (c).

subsection.text: Section 604 of the Expedited Funds Availability Act (12 U.S.C. 4003) is amended—

paragraph.text: in subsection (a)—

clause.text: in the matter following subparagraph (D) by striking on the business day after the business day on which such cash or funds are deposited or, in the case of a wire transfer, on the business day after the business day on which and inserting in real time after such cash or funds are deposited or, in the case of a wire transfer, in real time after; and
in the paragraph heading by striking Next Business Day and inserting Real Time;

subparagraph.text: by striking paragraph (3)(B) and inserting the following:
any such funds deposited in excess of such amount shall be available for withdrawal in real time.

subsection.text: Section 607 of the Expedited Funds Availability Act (12 U.S.C. 4006) is amended—

paragraph.text: by striking subsections (a) and (b); and
by redesignating subsections (c) through (f) as subsections (a) through (d), respectively.

subsection.text: Section 609 of the Expedited Funds Availability Act (12 U.S.C. 4008) is amended—

paragraph.text: by striking subsections (d) and (f); and
by redesignating subsection (e) as subsection (d).

subsection.text: The Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System shall create a real time payment system that—

paragraph.text: at a minimum, conforms with the principles outlined in the final report of the Faster Payments Task Force of the Federal Reserve System;
allows end users have fast access to funds, in speeds approaching real time;
operates as a utility, allowing end users to reach any other end user, including unbanked, underserved, and cross-border end users, regardless of the solution used by the end user;
prioritizes safety and soundness, consumer health, efficiency, and other relevant public interest considerations;
provides end users with the confidence and trust in the safety and security of the system by ensuring that—

subparagraph.text: fraud and errors are minimized and resolved quickly; and
the assets, accounts, and information of the end user are protected, even as payments cross different solutions;

paragraph.text: has transparent operating information; and
ensures that there are no volume discounts made that disadvantage smaller financial institutions.

subsection.text: In this section, the term real time payment system means a payment-by-payment interbank settlement system that facilitates settlements in real time and at any time, on any day, including weekends and holidays.
